title: "Join ITRN"
subtitle: "How to become a member of the Italian Reproducibility Network"
---

## How to join or renew

**To renew**, simply pay the fee and send an e-mail with a copy of the payment to [membership@itrn.org](mailto:membership@itrn.org).

**To register for ITRN**, you need to send an email to [membership@itrn.org](mailto:membership@itrn.org) with your name, surname, and type and duration of your subscription. You can sign in as a student, a researcher, an endorser, or in representation of an institution. You can also sign in for 1 year or for 3 years at a discounted rate (see below).

As an example, you can copy this template into your email:

```{.text filename="Application email template"}
I [Surname and name of applicant] would like to be a member of ITRN

Requested membership:  [ ] new   [ ] renewal
Category and duration: [select the category and the 1- or 3-year fee]

Position:
Affiliation:
```

## Membership fees

We had no fees until December 2022. Since we became a Registered Association, we need to face some costs and therefore a fee was necessary. These are the fees for 2024:

| Category | 1 year | 3 years |
|:---------|-------:|--------:|
| Institutional[^inst] | €250 | — |
| Endorser | ≥ €100 | — |
| Researcher / Professor / Clinician[^res] | €30 | €75 |
| Student[^stud] | €20 | €45 |

: {.striped .hover}

[^inst]: Institutional membership does not automatically grant individual membership to its affiliates. However, if an individual affiliated with a member institution wishes to join as a personal member, they qualify for a reduced personal membership fee of €5 for the same calendar year.

[^res]: Researcher, University Professor, PostDoc, Research assistant, Professional in the health area, Professional in the technical area, Librarian, Administrative, etc.

[^stud]: Student in university courses, doctorate, specialisation, postgraduate school etc.

## Payment

After acceptance of the application by the ITRN Steering Committee, a confirmation email will be sent.

In order to finalise your registration, you will then have to pay the membership fee, based on the information above, by bank transfer (*tramite bonifico bancario*).

::: {.callout-note icon="false"}
